enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket over shoulder. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to right side.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Put plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Buckle seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Check rearview mirror. Drive. Stop at intersection. Turn steering wheel. Park car. Turn off engine. Unbuckle seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Swipe badge. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Walk to nurses station. Pick up patient chart. Review patient history. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Write notes. Walk to next patient. Check medical supplies.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Buckle seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Check mirrors. Drive. Stop at intersection. Turn steering wheel. Park car. Turn off engine. Unbuckle seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Put plate in sink. Wash dishes. Dry dishes.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up magazine. Read magazine. Turn page. Put down magazine.

Open laptop. Turn on computer. Type password. Open browser. Navigate to website. Type. Click mouse. Scroll. Pick up controller. Turn on GameConsole. Play game. Press buttons. Put down controller. Pick up book. Read book. Turn page. Put down book. Stretch arms. Yawn. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth.

Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull covers over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Sleep.
